title: Strategy discovery v1 source registry
purpose: Define the permitted source families and collection-time admissibility tests for future deterministic candidate discovery.

admissibility: The paper defines an operational signal or provides a complete reproducible supplement.
Feature construction, timing, entry, exit, risk, and evaluation assumptions are explicit.
Any result used for prioritization is traceable to the paper version and section/table.
The SSRN abstract record and stable paper version are retained.
A candidate is admissible only when the rule set is fully disclosed or a reproducible code/data supplement is linked.
Unverified performance claims are not imported as metrics.
The complete research notebook or algorithm source is available at a stable revision.
The source specifies data timing, universe, execution, exits, and costs sufficiently for deterministic normalization.
A performance chart without the underlying rule disclosure is rejected.
Historical or mirrored material is admissible only when the full source and its revision are preserved.
Notebook prose alone is insufficient if it leaves execution, timing, or risk behavior ambiguous.
The archive is a source family, not permission to treat anonymous leaderboard results as evidence.
Public research is eligible as a hypothesis source only when the signal construction is sufficiently disclosed.
A broad factor narrative without deterministic entry, exit, and sizing rules remains a research reference, not a candidate.
Public quantitative research may be used only when a complete rule set or reproducible method is disclosed.
Marketing material, fund commentary, and return claims without operational rules are not candidate sources.
The observable event fields, aggregation window, clock, and missing-event behavior are specified.
The candidate's primary alpha is order-flow or microstructure-based rather than a prohibited standalone chart pattern.
Any exchange-specific assumption is recorded as a data requirement and not silently generalized.

conditional_pointer_sources.policy: A retail or marketing page may be retained only as a pointer when it links to a fully disclosed, unambiguous, independently verifiable rule set in an allowed source.
conditional_pointer_sources.required_action: Record the pointer only as provenance context; normalize and cite the underlying allowed source, never the marketing claim.

explicit_exclusions: generic TradingView script used as the primary source
90% win-rate or similar marketing claim without full rule disclosure
retail technical-analysis blog without a complete deterministic rule set
source that requires subjective visual interpretation
source that omits timing, exits, stop-loss, take-profit, or position-sizing rules
source whose rule set cannot be represented without guessing

rejection_reporting.granularity: summary counts by rejection_category and source_class
